purpose: Teach: 挙げる/鋭く/有権者/流入/伝染病/地形/能動/神宮

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、警察、絶対、容疑者、絶対、挙げる、絶対、ことができました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We were genuinely able to apprehend the suspect in this case. I'm deeply grateful for your cooperation.
lines.style: Official but warm. Measured cadence, clear enunciation on case details. Slight pause before 'grateful'—acknowledging the weight of the work. Steady eye contact, composed.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、警察、絶対、鋭く、絶対、追跡、絶対、されたんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: So the investigation tracked this quite sharply then? I really appreciate everything you've done.
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, not probing. Soft upward lift on the question. Respectful pause—he's listening more than speaking. Warm beneath the formality.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、有権者、絶対、への、絶対、影響、絶対、警察、絶対、検証中です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're still verifying the impact this case may have had on the community. Thank you for your patience with us.
lines.style: Careful, measured delivery. Each phrase gets its own small breath—procedural, methodical. Not distant, but precise. A hint of weight: this matters.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、不法、絶対、流入、絶対、品、絶対、警察、絶対、押収、絶対、されたんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: So the contraband was seized by your team? I'm genuinely grateful for how thorough this has been.
lines.style: Thoughtful, respectful. Slight wondering tone—not questioning competence, asking to understand. Genuine appreciation colors the close. Slow enough to let the words land.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、伝染病、絶対、対策、絶対、警察、絶対、保健所、絶対、連携、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're working closely with the health department on disease prevention measures related to this case. Thank you for your understanding.
lines.style: Professional, methodical. Measured pacing, clear on the inter-agency coordination. Not rushed. Acknowledges complexity without dwelling. Composed authority.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、現場の、絶対、地形、絶対、警察、絶対、調査、絶対、されたんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The terrain at the scene was thoroughly surveyed? I'm really impressed by how meticulously you've handled this.
lines.style: Thoughtful appreciation. Gentle question—he's noticing the care taken. Warm but not effusive. A small smile in the tone without being casual.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、能動、絶対、的な、絶対、捜査、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're conducting this investigation proactively, moving forward with concrete leads. I thank you for your support.
lines.style: Firmer now, forward-moving. Confidence in the pace—not rushed, but assured. 'Proactively' gets light emphasis. Professional warmth closing it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、神宮、絶対、付近の、絶対、警備、絶対、警察、絶対、強化、絶対、されたそうですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Security around the shrine area has been strengthened, I understand? I'm genuinely grateful for that level of care.
lines.style: Appreciative curiosity. Slightly wondering tone—pleased to hear this. Warm close. Let the gratitude breathe at the end, not forced. Respectful and genuine.
